title: Served source map embeds the original source code
description: The response is a source map whose sourcesContent field carries the original files. A map with only file names helps debugging; a map with sourcesContent publishes the pre-build source to anyone who opens the developer tools, including comments and internal URLs.
remediation: Build production maps without sourcesContent, serve maps only to authenticated users, or omit the maps from the public build.
limitation: One response body. The check proves the source text is embedded; it does not read the application code or decide whether that code is sensitive.

observation.body: Set devtool to hidden-source-map to drop the source reference from the bundle.
